title: How a Lighthouse Works
style: Polished 2D cel-animation cartoon, bold clean ink outlines, flat cel shading with simple hard-edged shadows, bright saturated palette, painted backgrounds of a rocky sea coast, original art, no logos, no watermark, no text in the image
music: Gentle, curious instrumental with plucked strings and soft marimba, light and steady, no vocals

pip.ref_prompt: Pip, a small round friendly robot with a matte teal body, one large round amber eye-lens, short stubby legs, two thin arms and a little yellow antenna
pip.description: Pip, a small round teal robot with one big amber eye-lens and a yellow antenna

shots.narration: At night, a ship cannot see the rocks near the shore.
shots.frame_prompt: A wooden sailing ship on a dark sea at night, jagged black rocks just ahead of it in the water, heavy clouds, seen from high above.
shots.video_prompt: The ship rocks on the waves and drifts slowly toward the rocks as clouds slide past, no speech, no subtitles.

shots.narration: So people built a tall tower with a bright lamp at the top: a lighthouse.
shots.frame_prompt: A tall red-and-white striped lighthouse on a rocky cliff at dusk, seen from below. Pip stands in the foreground on the cliff path, pointing up at the dark lamp room at the top.
shots.video_prompt: Pip points up at the top of the tower and the lamp flickers on, no speech, no subtitles.

shots.narration: Around the lamp sits a big glass lens that squeezes the light into one strong beam.
shots.frame_prompt: Inside the lamp room: a large beehive-shaped glass lens made of ringed prisms surrounds a glowing lamp. Pip stands beside it, amber eye wide, one hand resting on the brass frame.
shots.video_prompt: The lamp glows brighter and a single beam of light gathers and shoots out through the lens while Pip leans back, no speech, no subtitles.

shots.narration: The lens turns slowly, so from the sea the light seems to flash.
shots.frame_prompt: The lighthouse at night seen from the sea, one long beam of light reaching out over the dark water toward the left.
shots.video_prompt: The beam sweeps steadily across the water from left to right, no speech, no subtitles.

shots.narration: Sailors see the flash, know where the rocks are, and steer safely past.
shots.frame_prompt: The wooden sailing ship turning away from the black rocks, lit by the lighthouse beam. Pip stands on the cliff in the foreground, waving both arms at the ship.
shots.video_prompt: The ship curves away from the rocks into open water as Pip waves, no speech, no subtitles.
